protocol.question: Does the already defined absolute past BTC trend gate improve fixed direction economics versus relative GMM, isolating state coverage while keeping probabilities and account inputs exact?

labels.classes: SHORT below -37bp; LONG above +37bp; CASH otherwise; missing future stays missing

protocol.adoption: Retain as research challenger only if net or DD or Sharpe improves versus matched GMM in all four scenarios; raw baseline secondary. Negative or no consistent benefit pauses fixed recipe. Positive short claim requires cost-net SHORT and bear-state contribution positive across four scenarios plus adequate independent evidence; this development replay never qualifies investment.
protocol.stopping: One fixed prior rule; zero direction/regime/normalizer fits and zero search. Four new complete 122day shared accounts, 16 controls reused by immutable report/artifact identity and unchanged financial sources, exact 1220 probability rows. Stop on any input/cost mismatch or budget guard, retain negative results.

regime.policy: BULL allows original LONG; BEAR original SHORT; SIDEWAYS/HIGH_VOL_CRASH CASH, never invert or redistribute
regime.source: Existing D085/D086 descriptive state definition, zero changed thresholds

direction_model_reuse.availability: Retrospective replay with identical preMarch fit data cutoff; not actual historical deployed model, no validation early stopping or parameter choice

control_reuse.scope: 16 same122day completed controls, unchanged input/financial kernels, no account resimulation; old GMM states preserved and regrouped by fixed rule only for descriptive contributions
